name: Dr. Priyadarshini M.
outfit: Muhurtham Peacock Bridal Blouse & Saree Pallu
text: The precision on my Muhurtham blouse was beyond anything I envisioned! The 3D peacock feathers and bullion wire stayed intact through all the rituals. Every single guest complimented the royal zari shine. Aariwork is truly an atelier of master artists.

name: Ananya Ranganathan
outfit: Custom Floral Jaal Silk Blouse with Temple Kundan
text: Living in London, I was anxious about ordering a custom hand-embroidered blouse remotely. The team sent me weekly video updates from the adda frame! When the package arrived, the fit was millimetre-perfect. The craft is pure poetry.

name: Shivani & Kunal Singhania
text: They customized our wedding date and our initials discreetly woven into the floral jaal of my lehenga waist belt. The weight of the embroidery is balanced so well that I danced all night without strain. Absolute luxury experience.

name: Natasha Somani
outfit: Shahi Darbar Cutwork Dupatta & Raw Silk Blouse
text: Aariwork transformed a simple raw silk fabric into an heirloom piece. The cutwork scallops on the veil framed my face like vintage Mughal paintings. Worth every single rupee and artisan hour.

name: Meera Venkatakrishnan
outfit: Pure Kanjeevaram Saree Maggam Border Revival
text: They restored and embellished my mother's 40-year-old wedding saree with new Aari zari borders without damaging the fragile silk. Their respect for traditional textiles is unmatched. True custodians of our heritage.

name: Kavitha Subramaniam
outfit: Heritage Kanjivaram Blouse with Meenakari Detailing
text: I cannot express how deeply moved I was when I unboxed my bridal blouse. The meenakari colors are so vibrant and the gold thread catches light in the most divine way. My mother-in-law said it looked like jewelry stitched into silk!
